sloka: आत्मा हि दाराः सर्वेषाम् दारसम्ग्रहवर्तिनाम् ।आत्मेयमिति रामस्य पालयिष्यति मेदिनीम् ॥२-३७-२४॥
transliteration: ātmā hi dārāḥ sarveṣām dārasamgrahavartinām ।ātmeyamiti rāmasya pālayiṣyati medinīm ॥2-37-24॥

translations.english: For every householder, his wife is the soul. Since Sita is the soul of Rama, she can rule this earth.
